about.name: Coach James Breland
about.title: DC
about.bio:
Coach James Breland is a defensive football specialist with years of coaching experience at Sumter High School. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Breland develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Breland's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Sumter High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Multiple Defense Installation
services.description: Full Multiple system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
